_comment: 11AIBlockchain scenario - direct-trust leg only (Leg 3: no CIMD, no ID-JAG), a normal pre-registered OAuth 2.1 client at whatever AS the partner already trusts. Authority/ClientId/ClientSecret below default to this repo's own local Keycloak client (mcpinterop-partner-direct, see deploy/keycloak/import/mcpinterop-realm.json) as a working placeholder - real 11 AI Blockchain values (their AS, their pre-registered client, their MCP server endpoint) are a future follow-up. Send Authority to the partner so they can allowlist it. ClientSecret below is the local Keycloak client's throwaway secret (already public in mcpinterop-realm.json) - for a real hosted AS, use 'dotnet user-secrets set "Client:ClientSecret" "..." --project src/OpenID.MCPInterop.Client' instead.
